name: EtherFreakers capture pays out before settling the target, transfer hook re-dissipates stale energy
summary: In EtherFreakers.attack(), a successful capture sends the target's full energy to the defender and then transfers the NFT; the ERC-721 _beforeTokenTransfer hook recomputes the target's energy from its not-yet-updated balance and dissipates 0.1% of that already-paid energy into the global freakerIndex. The index therefore grows without ETH backing. Attackers minted fresh Freakers, charged them with flash-loaned ETH, looped captures between their own tokens to inflate the index, and discharged more ETH than they put in, draining the contract's 17.87 ETH over two campaigns.

loss.notes: Net ETH paid out by the EtherFreakers contract across the 23 successful campaign transactions (3 by 0x7ef9ac48, 20 by 0xbe9ef50f), i.e. discharges minus the attackers' own birth and charge payments into the contract. The total equals the contract's balance drop from 17.876119787873554828 ETH (block 24602559) to 0.007904525048744983 ETH (block 24614227). Valued at WETH prices at each campaign's first transaction; flash loans are excluded.

ageReset.description: Direct immutable EtherFreakers runtime (the contract has no owner or admin functions); the ordering flaw exists from deployment.

limitations: 38 ordinary 2021 Captured events (blocks 12117639..12344690) also ran the stale-hook dissipation (0.1% of each target's energy) without any looping or extraction; they are treated as benign use, not as earlier exploits. If the dataset instead anchors on the first capture ever (block 12117639, 2021-03-26), the age collapses to about four days.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Verified EtherFreakers source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode chainid=1, v0.8.2+commit.661d1103, optimizer 1000 runs; SHA-256 of SourceCode 497827406c59965173f8ccaa0fef4c9165d559a608fae2e9efb9acae5965adaa), contracts/EtherFreakers.sol attack(uint128,uint128) capture branch: targetCharge = energyOf(targetId); payable(defender).send(targetCharge); _transfer(defender, attacker, targetId); _dissipateEnergyIntoPool(sourceSpent); only then energyBalances[targetId] is rewritten. _beforeTokenTransfer for a from/to transfer reads energyOf(freakerId) (still the pre-payout balance), stores basic = charge - charge/1000 and calls _dissipateEnergyIntoPool(charge/1000), which raises freakerIndex by 80% of it / totalFortune with no ETH entering. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 24602560, index 5, EOA 0x7ef9ac487b5ec857e24460fb85e40d2890f7b758 -> 0x043d19e8466279c78958ca837e05e9c131bc3d67 selector 0xfc39c740): 11 birthTo (0x9a0f0b3f), 28 charge (0x3f9c726a), 14 attack (0x40dedc02) with 13 Captured events between the attacker's own tokens (source 409 / target 419 repeatedly), 14 transferFrom returning the captured token, and 39 discharge (0x7f538954); EF sends 21042.619318047728 ETH and receives 21042.47282 ETH, net 0.146498047725371332 ETH out. First exercise: eth_getLogs Captured(address,address,uint128,uint128) (topic 0x5405274d...) on the contract from deployment to block 24612862 returns 64 events: 38 in 2021 gameplay (from block 12117639) and 26 in the two 0x7ef9ac48 transactions source-1 and 0x12f96463f686bb0fe08211f3ff0a002e8c3afe68aab9b81243154b6a76033d1e; from 24602560 to 24800000 there are 270 Captured events in 11 transactions, all from 0x7ef9ac48 (3) or 0xbe9ef50f532c04e66629faaddeee19a15a856c84 (8). The 2021 captures are single gameplay attacks with no charge/discharge loop and no extraction, so source-1 is the first exploit. Artifact: eth_getCode is 0x at 12087256; keccak256 0xbacddc01bdce9b48bf60ecc2fdadb6f9ecbda26800f20ceb40856c8b7c27c34e at 12087257 and 24602559; source-2 is its top-level creation (index 171) by 0xd4b02f20e2d4b4aef3aee86d0f2e502a1244a609. The contract has no proxy, delegatecall or self-destruct path. Deployment supplies the age.

Reviewed loss. For every successful transaction sent by the two attacker EOAs (Etherscan V2 account.txlist), debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) native value into and out of 0x3a275655 (non-reverted frames) gives net ETH out: 0x7ef9ac48 campaign 146498047725371332 (source-1), 737978051133889760 (0x12f96463..., block 24608335), 2176639889924423502 (0xd90490e59a4b25e2d2417b060ae33e4b70172945c9b5779c73c8031b04dd0f42, block 24614087), total 3.061115988783684594 ETH; 0xbe9ef50f campaign: 8 attack-loop transactions from source-5 (block 24612863, index 3) to 0x89e24dbfddcbc566c4b5f539e588bacee9ef72682119892977afa0279abd2942 (block 24613530; 7.497952352274679518 ETH, the transaction BlockSec analysed) and 12 discharge transactions via helper contracts to 0x3d20719c590b677789b32c0ca0f1183d530b5ef399770c942a6c403571eaedb7 (block 24614227), total 14.807099274041125251 ETH. The 161 Freakers the second campaign discharged (ids 431..591) were all minted by it (161 birthTo calls). Sum 17.868215262824809845 ETH = eth_getBalance(contract) 17876119787873554828 at 24602559 minus 7904525048744983 at 24614227.
